name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent, feet flat, and shoulder blades set back.
Press two dumbbells straight above your chest with palms facing forward or slightly inward.
Bend your elbows diagonally away from your ribs until the backs of your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly on the floor, then press both dumbbells back above your shoulders.
tips: Pause softly at the floor to avoid bouncing your elbows off the ground.
Keep each wrist stacked straight above its elbow throughout the press.
